title: Herping
summary: Drive a dark PNW road at night and find salamanders by their eyeshine.
intro: Herping has always been a big part of my life, even before I knew what the word meant. Growing up in Minnesota, I'd find big tiger salamanders on the driveway after a rainy day, or flip the hay bales in my backyard to find garter snakes. Moving to Washington, with so many more amphibians and reptiles out here, let me take it much further, and now I go herping most weeks. On wet nights salamanders and frogs cross the road, so this is a night drive where you watch for their eyeshine. Take the wheel.
